title: Spy
blurb: Everyone gets the same word except the spy. Ask questions and catch them.

setup.lead: Everyone gets the same word except the spy. Pass the phone, ask questions, catch the spy.
setup.needMorePlayers: Add players (7 or more) to play with 2 spies.
setup.spySeesSub: The spy's card shows the category
setup.noPacks: No word packs are on. Turn on a region in Settings.

pass.label: Pass the phone to
pass.hint: Make sure nobody else is looking 👀

card.spyNoCategory: Listen to their questions and guess the word

round.rules: Take turns asking each other questions. When you're ready, vote on who the spy is.
round.scoring: Spy not caught: spy +2. Caught but guessed the word: spy +1. Caught and guessed wrong: everyone else +1.

setup: Choose how many players and spies, and add names if you like.
Pick a category, or keep 🎲 Random for a new one every round.
Choose a punishment level for the losers.
Tap Start and hand the phone to the first player.
play: Each player taps the card to see the secret word, then hides it and passes the phone on.
The spy only sees “You're the spy!” (and the category, if that option is on).
Take turns asking each other questions about the word, without making it too obvious.
When you're ready, point at who you think the spy is, then reveal the answer.
Spy not caught: spy +2. Caught but guessed the word: spy +1. Caught and wrong: everyone else +1.
